'''Special Forces Command''', also shortened to '''SpecForce Command''' or '''SpecCom''', was the command element of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Chief of Special Forces Command]] was [[General/Legends|General]] [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]].<ref name="RASB" /> The [[HT-2200 medium freighter]] ''[[Reekeene's Retribution]]'' had a direct communications link to SpecForce Command from the briefing room aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="SS">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>

The ship ''[[Reekeene's Retribution]]'', which was a resource of the elite Alliance SpecForce team [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], had a tactical briefing room with a direct communications link with Special Forces Command.<ref name="ss">''[[Stock Ships]]''</ref>
